children: Genmab reported updated Phase 2 data for petosemtamab plus chemo in metastatic colorectal cancer: ORR 75% in 1L and 67% in 2L, with 81% in 1L left-sided tumors; median follow-up 5.9 and 7.1 months. Most previously unconfirmed responses were confirmed.

High response rate vs historical EGFR/chemo benchmarks could signal competitive efficacy in front-line mCRC.
2L ORR 67%
Maintained activity after prior regimen supports value beyond 1L and broadens addressable use.
1L left-sided ORR 81%
Key subgroup for EGFR strategies; strong ORR may challenge incumbents if sustained in Phase 3.
Disease control 95% (1L), 93% (2L)
Signals breadth of activity; could translate to PFS benefit if confirmed.
Grade 3 IRRs 7% (FOLFOX), 3% (FOLFIRI)
Manageable safety profile; low discontinuation (5%/3%) reduces adoption risk.
Phase 3 LiGeR CRC trials ongoing
Next catalysts hinge on pivotal readouts; path to registration if efficacy holds.
